legend.NO_CHANGE: the book, its commit log and its projection already agree
legend.RECOVERED: the committed book is intact and was reconciled with log/projection; nothing was replayed
legend.REFUSED_CORRUPTION: a committed artefact does not verify; the runtime stops
legend.REFUSED_AMBIGUOUS_COMMIT: the current generation cannot be named
legend.BLOCKED_LOCK: a live process owns the book
